activity_summary: After morning prayer Master Thwaite did not come in to eat. The sword went before Sir John for the last Sunday, and he did not speak. You said you were not going up the lane. The letter can wait in the coffer for the carrier of the thirteenth. Mistress Ansell told you not to send a supper-story. The loaf is a penny and a full thumb short of the notch. You did not argue it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the supper-story and the argument about the loaf.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Ended the morning and did not ask Sir John for a word.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Priced the loaf, named the sword, and barred a story fit for strangers.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Went out behind the sword and did not speak.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named at home, and not in the porch.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Named on the settle, and not moved.
